text:
maria: quick heads up — p95 for /chat-gen climbed on the canary after the kernel-selector tweak. looks correlated with KV hotset churn under ~4k concurrent reqs.

simon: any logs or flamegraphs?

maria: posting short profiling snippet from the canary:
```
requests: 4k conc
p95: 210ms -> 370ms
eviction_rate: 0.18 -> 0.42
kernel: preferred fast_attention -> fallback_generic_matmul
kv_lock_latency_p50: 0.9ms -> 4.2ms
```

kai: this smells like hotspot keys causing constant invalidation + microbatch packing at size=8. when batches accumulate on same hot keys we thrash the KV cache and force kernel fallback.

perf-bot: :warning: perf-alert: canary p95 increased 76% vs baseline (auto-detected)

maria: repro'd locally with stress harness: microbatch=8, concurrency=4k. lowering microbatch to 4 reduces p95 back to ~220ms in the harness. Also tried a simple KV backoff (sleep 10ms on eviction hot-path) and saw p99 tail tighten.

simon: can we do an adaptive policy instead of hardcoding? hysteresis on eviction threshold + microbatch downscaling when eviction_rate > 0.25?

kai: plan: add "kv_hotspot_backoff" gating in runtime: when eviction_rate > up_threshold -> scale_mb = max(1, mb/2); when eviction_rate < down_threshold -> restore. up_threshold=0.25, down_threshold=0.12. also add short randomized jitter to backoff to avoid sync. i'll PR to runtime/microbatch.

maria: SGTM. i'll deploy gate in the canary at 10% and run the perf harness loop for 6h. watching p95/p99 and eviction_rate metrics.

simon: add a tracing tag for kernel_fallback_reason so we can split by fallback type in dashboards.

kai: will do. quick config snippet i'm going to use in the canary:
```yaml
microbatch:
  default_size: 8
  adaptive_gate: true
  up_threshold: 0.25
  down_threshold: 0.12
  backoff_ms: 12
  jitter_ms: 4
```

maria: nice. also note: if we see p99 spikes persist, we'll try a per-model kv-hotset limit (reject caching for extremely hot prefixes) as a last resort.

perf-bot: :eyes: canary deployment started (10%) — monitoring p95/p99, eviction_rate, kernel_fallbacks

maria: thanks — i'll post results in ~3h or sooner if anything flares. :thumbsup:
